summary.ja: 電子密度のPoisson解法を、静電気の符号・単位・境界とともに扱う。
summary.en: Solve Poisson for electronic charge with explicit signs, units and boundaries.

references.label: Hartree, D. R. (1928), The Wave Mechanics of an Atom with a Non-Coulomb Central Field. Part I. Theory and Methods
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

references.label: Kohn, W.; Sham, L. J. (1965), Self-Consistent Equations Including Exchange and Correlation Effects
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Nonrelativistic isolated atom; infinite-mass point nucleus.
Reduced radial orbitals on a second-order uniform finite-difference grid.
He is restricted to a closed-shell spherical 1s² state; both HF and LDA_X omit correlation.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0; hydrogenic r_max=60 bohr, He r_max=16 bohr, with separate domain studies.

next_deliverable.ja: 孤立と周期の小規模参照例。
next_deliverable.en: Small isolated and periodic reference examples.

limitations.ja: 球対称孤立密度のCoulomb積分を累積和で評価。解析的な指数密度で符号・係数・自己項の数え方を検証。一般の3Dや周期のPoisson実装ではありません。
limitations.en: Cumulative Coulomb quadrature for isolated spherical densities, checked against analytic exponential densities; not a general 3D or periodic Poisson implementation.

metadata_review.level: scoped radial educational implementation; analytic and independently computed PySCF reference checks; see separate quantum-atoms code edition

assumptions_ja: 非相対論・孤立原子・無限質量の点核。
一様動径格子と2次中心差分による縮約動径軌道。
Heは閉殻・球対称1s²に限定し、HFとLDA_Xともに相関を含まない。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。水素型はr_max=60 bohr、Heは16 bohrを基本に領域依存を別途検査。

caution.ja: Poisson解の残差、積分した電子数、遠方の挙動、二重計数の1/2を別々に確かめます。周期セルの帯電系を孤立系のエネルギーとして解釈しません。
caution.en: Check the Poisson residual, integrated electron number, far-field behavior and the one-half double-counting factor separately. A charged periodic cell does not directly give an isolated-system energy.

example_scope.ja: 球対称孤立密度のCoulomb積分を累積和で評価。解析的な指数密度で符号・係数・自己項の数え方を検証。一般の3Dや周期のPoisson実装ではありません。
example_scope.en: Cumulative Coulomb quadrature for isolated spherical densities, checked against analytic exponential densities; not a general 3D or periodic Poisson implementation.
